Let me look at where your bench is right now before I answer. Nothing is logged yet for bench, a program, or goals, so I'm starting from general principles rather than your numbers.

To build a bigger bench, most people do best benching two or three times a week. One day is heavy, in the 3 to 6 rep range. One is lighter or higher-rep, around 8 to 12. Add a third, moderate day if recovery allows. Keep most sets a rep or two short of failure and add a little weight or a rep over time.

The support work matters as much as the bench itself. That means rows and pull-ups to keep the shoulders healthy, triceps work, and some overhead pressing. Frequency and steady progression beat grinding one max-effort day.

I can build you a program with bench as the priority lift. Tell me how many days a week you can train, how long your sessions run, and whether you have a target number in mind. I'll hand it to the app to build.
